name: Kissa Tanto
dinnerNote: Omakase menu, from (also à la carte)

menus.name: Omakase menu
menus.note: Booked as an omakase table (2 to 6 guests) or at the bar (1 or 2); premium menus at $250 and $350, and one with no set price, use more luxury ingredients. The rest of the dining room orders à la carte.

bookingOpens: Online on Tock, for parties of up to six. Tables open 30 days ahead at midnight Vancouver time.
cancellation: Tock holds a card for each guest: $50 for the dining room and bar, $75 for the omakase. Dining room and bar bookings can be changed or cancelled up to a day ahead, omakase tables up to three days ahead; the bar omakase is non-refundable. Changes are made on Tock.
groups: The dining room has one large table, for up to six guests. Groups of five or six are served the omakase.
byob: Guests may bring their own wine: corkage is $75 a bottle, at most two 750ml bottles per booking.
photoAlt: Kissa Tanto's red brick front and named awning in Chinatown, Vancouver
